studies.title: Earth-observing satellites
studies.caption: Landsat 1 begins photographing the whole land surface every 18 days. The same year Apollo 17's crew photographs the whole Earth.
studies.prompt: Orbital observation study of Landsat1 in1972, compact Nimbus-derived Earth Resources Technology Satellite with two rectangular solar panel wings and a boxlike sensor platform aimed down at curving Earth, blue-green land and cloud bands. No giant space station, no modern telescope or six-wing GPS satellite.
